headlines.title: Armed Man Arrested After Lunging at Ohio Governor Candidate
headlines.description: Authorities say an armed man lunged at Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton as she spoke at a local fair on Sunday. Her campaign says security stopped the man from reaching the candidate, but several people were injured as he pushed his way through the crowd. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: Amazon Cargo Plane Overruns Runway in Miami, Killing at Least 5
headlines.description: At least five people were killed and several others injured when an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday. Officials said the aircraft struck multiple vehicles before stopping near a parking lot, triggering a ground stop and widespread flight disruptions. NBC’s George Solis reports and Tom Costello joins TODAY on the key questions federal investigators will be asking to determine what caused the crash.

headlines.title: Post-Labor Day Weekend Travel Rush Underway Across US
headlines.description: Millions are taking to the skies and roads as Americans return home from the long Labor Day holiday weekend. NBC’s Ryan Chandler reports and Saturday TODAY meteorologist Angie Lassman tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy Case Ends in Mistrial: Will She Be Tried Again?
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s future remains uncertain after a mistrial was declared Friday in her triple murder case. Now the district attorney is left to contemplate a retrial. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports and legal analyst Danny Cevallos joins TODAY with insight into what may come next.

headlines.title: Get a First Look at Elizabeth Holmes Doc ‘You Can See Everything’
headlines.description: A trailer is out for “You Can See Everything,” a documentary directed by Nathan Fielder that focuses on Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes leading up to her imprisonment after she was convicted of fraud. Get a first look!

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.
